name: get_user_profile
description: Retrieves a borrower profile, loan history, and risk information for a given user ID from data/users.json.

inputs_required.name: user_id
inputs_required.description: Unique borrower ID, for example U001.

name: check_loan_eligibility
description: Checks loan eligibility using income, expenses, credit score, missed payments, and existing loan liabilities.

inputs_required.name: user_profile
inputs_required.description: Full borrower profile object containing monthly_income, monthly_expenses, credit_score, missed_payments_last_12m, and existing_loans.

name: calculate_emi
description: Calculates the monthly EMI for a loan using principal, annual interest rate, and tenure in months.

inputs_required.name: rate
inputs_required.description: Annual loan interest rate as a percentage, for example 11.5.

name: calculate_dti
description: Calculates debt-to-income ratio using existing loan EMIs and monthly income, then returns a risk category.

inputs_required.name: user_profile
inputs_required.description: Full borrower profile object containing monthly_income and existing_loans with EMI values.

name: simulate_repayment_plan
description: Simulates a repayment plan and returns EMI, total payable amount, and total interest paid.

inputs_required.name: amount
inputs_required.description: Loan amount or repayment principal to simulate.

inputs_required.name: interest_rate
inputs_required.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage, for example 11.5.

name: assess_borrower_risk
description: Assesses borrower risk using missed payments, DTI ratio, credit score, and savings buffer.

inputs_required.name: user_profile
inputs_required.description: Full borrower profile object containing monthly income, expenses, credit score, missed payments, savings, and existing loans.
